title: Media Client
description: Videos and music from your Jellyfin server: video on the instrument cluster (middle or whole) or the HUD - the picture only while parked, the sound through the car's speakers also while driving. Enter the server's address, then sign in with Quick Connect (a code in your Jellyfin app) or user name and password.

de.bmw.infotainment.controlelements.Fron._optional: the iDrive controller for the lists and the keyboard (touch still works without it)

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._optional: the speed: the video picture only while parked

de.bmw.infrastructure.VehicleInformation._optional: the selector position: the video picture only in P

org.genivi.am.commandinterface.CommandCo._optional: the sound: the app's source on the media sink

settings.label: Video on
options: MGU display (this screen, the Player page)

settings.label: Video quality
options: Sharp (640x360; 15 fps on the cluster / HUD to fit their upload limit)

settings.label: Video buffer (fetched ahead onto the unit's flash)
options: 10 minutes (about 100 MB, emptied at the end)
